title: How much higher in percentage is Ariel Borysiuk's overall rating than that
question:
How much higher in percentage is Ariel Borysiuk's overall rating than that of Paulin Puel?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: how much higher in percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(overall_rating WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk', overall_rating WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'), overall_rating WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'), 100);

prediction.sql: SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.XCL_132 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.XCL_132 END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.XCL_132 END) AS percentage_difference FROM Player AS "p" JOIN Player_Attributes AS "pa" ON "pa".XCL_130 = "p".XCL_122 WHERE p.XCL_123 IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')

arguments.sql:
SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.XCL_132 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.XCL_132 END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.XCL_132 END) AS percentage_difference
